map.string: Touch
Says who touched it
Listener
Hears a channel, and says what it heard to its owner

local CHANNEL = 7
ll.Listen(CHANNEL, "", NULL_KEY, "")
LLEvents:on("listen", function(channel, name, id, message) print(name .. " said: " .. message) end)
Timer
Does something every second
Dialog menu
A menu for whoever touches it, answered on a channel of its own

local BUTTONS = { "Red", "Green", "Blue" } local COLOURS = { Red = vector(1, 0, 0), Green = vector(0, 1, 0), Blue = vector(0, 0, 1) } local listening = nil local expiry = nil
local function stopListening() if listening then ll.ListenRemove(listening) listening = nil end if expiry then LLTimers:off(expiry) expiry = nil end end
LLEvents:on("touch_start", function(detected) local toucher = detected[1]:getKey() stopListening() local channel = -1 - math.random(1000000) listening = ll.Listen(channel, "", toucher, "") ll.Dialog(toucher, "Choose a colour.", BUTTONS, channel) expiry = LLTimers:once(30, stopListening) end)
LLEvents:on("listen", function(channel, name, id, message) stopListening() local colour = COLOURS[message] if colour then ll.SetColor(colour, ALL_SIDES) end end)
Sensor
Tells its owner who is near, every few seconds

ll.SensorRepeat("", NULL_KEY, AGENT, 20.0, PI, 5.0)
LLEvents:on("sensor", function(detected) for _, one in detected do local away = vector.magnitude(ll.GetPos() - one:getPos()) print(one:getName() .. " is " .. math.round(away) .. " m away.") end end)
LLEvents:on("no_sensor", function() print("Nobody near.") end)
HTTP request
Asks a web address when touched, and says what came back

local request = nil
LLEvents:on("touch_start", function(detected) request = ll.HTTPRequest("https://example.com/", { HTTP_METHOD, "GET" }, "") end)
LLEvents:on("http_response", function(request_id, status, metadata, body) if request_id == request then print("HTTP " .. status .. ": " .. string.sub(body, 1, 200)) end end)
Notecard reader
Reads a notecard in the object a line at a time

local NOTECARD = "config" local line = 0 local query = nil
local function readNext() query = ll.GetNotecardLine(NOTECARD, line) end
LLEvents:on("dataserver", function(query_id, data) if query_id ~= query then return end if data == EOF then print("Read " .. line .. " lines.") return end print(data) line += 1 readNext() end)
LLEvents:on("changed", function(change) if bit32.btest(change, CHANGED_INVENTORY) then ll.ResetScript() end end)
if ll.GetInventoryType(NOTECARD) == INVENTORY_NOTECARD then readNext() else print("No notecard called " .. NOTECARD .. " in this object.") end
